en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Yahya ibn Abi 'Imran has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya ibn Abi 'Imran.
He was a student of Yunus ibn 'Abd Al-Rahman.
